name: Malibu: Golden Hours
source:
Malibu: Golden Hours is a linear adult visual novel about desire, freedom, and the courage to choose the life you truly want.

Set against the sun-bleached coast of Malibu, California, you follow the story of a 32-year-old college tutor who participates in an exchange program. After arriving at his host family’s home, he slowly realizes that this place, and the people in it, are changing him. What begins as temptation turns into connection. What feels reckless starts to feel honest.

Over the course of a few intense summer days, you will grow closer to three very different women, each navigating their own relationship with pleasure, ambition, and self-acceptance.

Do you return to your safe, familiar life, or stay and embrace your newly found freedom?

[From [url=https://privateframegames.itch.io/malibu-golden-hours]itch.io[/url]]
